_comments: Entities read on a schedule with a filter that embeds the current time.
The RunView cache fingerprint includes the filter, so every poll minted a new permanent cache
key that was never read again and published a pub/sub event to every peer server and, through
the MJAPI relay, an invalidation to every connected browser. In one production Redis 97% of the
keys were this shape (the User Routine dispatcher, every minute). AllowCaching=false stops the
write at source (LocalCacheManager.SetRunViewResult honours it as a write gate).
Polled every 60 s by the scheduled bridge runner with ScheduledStartTime <= now.
Append-only log table; the retention driver reads it with a StartedAt < cutoff filter per run.
